findings: The existing VS=U1701.9 and actual GND=U1701.8 mapping is confirmed; ENABLE is pin 4. No pin-map or gate change is required.
The bypass capacitor belongs close to VS and GND; source project distance targets remain assumptions rather than manufacturer numeric limits.
RLIMIT needs a direct return to the actual device ground terminal. Plane-net continuity alone does not meet this layout requirement.
scope: Live read of the TI primary datasheet; no claim of complete manufacturer layout qualification.
